development.role: population-level RNA regulatory architecture plus matched chromatin-accessibility context across source-defined vemurafenib timepoints

internal_validation.role: distinct subclone/drug/holiday trajectories; used only after B2/B3 development definitions are frozen

cross_cell_line_transfer.role: same-paper cross-cell-line transport check after WM989 freeze

external_confirmation.role: future independent study not used in current definition

carrier_contract.development_carrier: population x treatment-time x biological replicate
carrier_contract.rna_batch_handling: sequencing-run identity is a nuisance/blocking variable and may not be interpreted as biological trajectory

B2_preanalysis_rule: modal representation must be unsupervised with respect to resistance outcome and defined from development data only
B3_preanalysis_rule: realized resistance/recovery endpoint and native/simple comparators must be frozen before target values are opened
feature_selection_rule: no resistance-marker or outcome-selected gene panel may define the primary bridge
promotion_rule: GSE97681 and WM983B cannot be described as external confirmation because they belong to the same publication/source lineage
next_action: freeze preprocessing, common-gene universe, modal construction, and native comparator before any B2 target calculation
